All variants begin from a meaningful admitted followup workflow, then diagnose the authored candidate. A fresh candidate root respects immutable production cache semantics. Parent/host relationships, action criteria and user dependencies remain exercised; no scheduler, delivery or external-row-existence claim.

Every accepted example now passes schema and commit admission; direct-link/operation candidates begin from admitted bases. Repaired forbidden standard-property declarations, missing child display workflow, missing conditional-link fallback, absent destination columns and missing cross-type carried case identity. Scalar and restored-capacity neighbors prove actual admission. Read all 1636 baseline lines, full 1226-line case-operation rule, 1032-line operation-order owner and operation wire contract. Fuzzy-date uses an actual date property, and calendar refusal has typed date assignment plus exact reason/interval. Native Core/HQ execution and SQL atomicity remain separate integration claims.
